# OverCue Desktop 2.2.20 for Mac

- Add optional Normalize volume for exported USB tracks, independently of stems or together in one flow. Targets −18 LUFS while preserving musical dynamics and allowing for peak headroom.
- Keep existing stems balanced with each track’s volume adjustment and account for normalization when stems are added later.
- Process multiple tracks with CPU, memory and temporary-storage limits adapted to the computer, while keeping the track list responsive.
- Load tracks and playlists before background stem checks finish, avoid repeated checks during processing, and show completed volume results promptly.
- Support MP3, PCM WAV, AIFF and FLAC, including more production-software metadata layouts and MP3 encoder variants, while preserving playback timing, cues and beatgrids.
- Explain the difference between automatic stem level protection and optional volume matching, with clearer progress and practical help. Computer originals stay unchanged; USB audio backups are not kept.
